values./items/@68a2147fca819c1c/system/effect: Road Leathers, Sharpshooter’s Pipe Revolver (Sharpshooter’s Grip mod), Tire Iron, Wealth 1.
values./items/@47289d3fb1f19469/system/descript: A simple L-shaped tool found commonly in cars and garages; tire irons make for handy weapons when not being used to change the tires on a car.
values./items/@9fefe70486c1e387/system/descript: A crude, homemade weapon, normally seen in the hands of those who can’t make, buy, or scavenge anything better, pipe guns are crude and somewhat unreliable, but effective enough. The most common form of pipe gun is a simple little semi-auto handgun, chambered for the common .38 round, but enterprising (or desperate) souls have been known to modify these guns for automatic fire or precision sniping.
values./items/@13216a504d530ac5/system/descript: Once per combat, Rad Rocky may ‘let rip’ with a volley from his Pipe Gun. This adds the weapon’s Fire Rate of 1 to the weapon’s damage for a single attack (for 5 CD total).
values./items/@c155996e68fb44e0/system/descript: If Rad Rocky is the only remaining enemy, he will attempt to flee the battle.
